name: Agent HQ capability tools
description: Fetches Agent HQ assigned tools and registers them as native OpenClaw tools.

apiUrl.description: Agent HQ API base URL. Defaults to AGENT_HQ_API_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:3501.

apiTokenFile.description: File holding the Agent HQ credential: the token alone, or dotenv lines with AGENT_HQ_OPERATOR_TOKEN (such as ~/.agent-hq/.env).

apiToken.description: Agent HQ credential sent as a bearer token. Prefer apiTokenFile, which keeps the secret out of this config.
